name: au-coal-lsl-levy
description: Use this guide for the Australian black coal mining industry portable long service leave payroll levy: whether an employer and each worker are covered (Coal Mining Industry (Long Service Leave) Administration Act 1992 s 4), eligible wages under s 3B of the Payroll Levy Collection Act 1992, the levy rate, the monthly Levy Advice return and payment, additional levy, adjustments and the annual audit report. Covers national system employers, including contractors and labour hire firms, for 2026-27. Trigger on 'Coal LSL', 'coal long service leave levy', 'Levy Advice', 'eligible wages' or 'black coal mining payroll'.
